justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java` (roughly lines 7528-7870). `TokenizedGenericType` is a cohesive lazy-projection helper for one concern: converting `GenericTypeToken` and descriptor data into `Generic`/`TypeDescription` views. The block contains 4 small nested helper classes (`TokenList`, `TypeVariableList`, `Malformed`, `Malformed.TokenList`) and 21 total methods/constructors, but they are narrowly focused and mostly delegate to token-to-type resolution rather than implementing separate responsibilities, so I did not find evidence of insufficient modularization.
